verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms is operated through its own APIs: API-only onboarding, the Legal Entity Management API and the Configuration API. Test credentials allow integration testing, so core operations can run headlessly without the Dashboard UI. There is no documented CLI, CI integration guide or pipeline-oriented tooling, so headless/CI automation is implied by the API-first design rather than shown. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific tooling, documented CI/pipeline workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You make API requests to create resources and submit the user data to Adyen.
You can create balance accounts manually using the Configuration API.
To manage legal entities, use the Legal Entity Management API.
Test the different types of transactions with Adyen that your integration handles using test credentials
